subject: gk
question: According to the Preamble, what does the promotion of fraternity assure?

options.text: Unity and integrity of the nation
Allows all to profess, preach and practice any religion
Thought, expression, belief, faith and worship

solution:
The correct answer is __**Unity and integrity of the nation**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Unity and integrity of the nation** are assured by the promotion of fraternity as mentioned in the Preamble of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The Preamble serves as an introductory statement to the Constitution, laying down the guiding principles and philosophy of the document.
 
• It aims to secure justice, liberty, equality to all citizens and promote fraternity to maintain the unity and integrity of the nation.
 
• Fraternity in the context of the Preamble refers to a sense of brotherhood among all Indians, transcending regional, religious, and linguistic differences.
 
• This principle is vital for maintaining national unity and fostering a sense of belonging among citizens.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Preamble of the Indian Constitution was adopted on **26th November 1949** and came into effect on **26th January 1950**.
 
• It declares India to be a **sovereign, socialist, secular, and democratic republic**.
 
• The Preamble highlights the objectives of the Constitution: **Justice, Liberty, Equality, and Fraternity**.
 
• The Preamble is considered a part of the Constitution and can be used to interpret ambiguous areas of the law.
 
• The principles enshrined in the Preamble are reflected in various provisions of the Constitution, ensuring they guide the interpretation and application of the law.
